title: Fed builds credibility, but hawkish turn leaves investors edgy
description: In a significant move, the Federal Reserve has raised interest rates for the first time since 2023, marking a shift towards a hawkish stance on inflation management. This unanimous choice has led investors to brace for more potential rate increases, generating ripple effects across asset markets. Following a surge, bond yields have retracted. Yet, the future trajectory of the Fed's monetary policy remains uncertain.

title: CoreWeave launches $3 billion convertible debt sale
description: CoreWeave is set to secure $3 billion via convertible debt offerings to significantly enhance its artificial intelligence infrastructure. In conjunction with this, they have initiated an at-the-market stock sale program to generate extra capital. This strategic move is pivotal in strengthening their credit profile and sustaining operations, underscoring the growing financial demands within the AI industry.

title: US stocks today: S&P, Nasdaq soar 1% at open as easing oil prices boost Fed hike relief
description: US stocks opened higher on Thursday as falling oil prices improved investor sentiment following the Federal Reserve's first rate hike under Chair Kevin Warsh. The Dow rose 0.82%, the S&P 500 gained 1.05% and the Nasdaq climbed 1.54% at the open, extending gains across major indexes.

title: NSE enters India’s mega-IPO club: 2nd-largest issue, 2nd-highest anchor count with 189 investors
description: NSE’s Rs 22,561.57 crore IPO ranks as India’s second-largest, behind Hyundai Motor India. The exchange attracted 189 anchor investors and raised Rs 6,746.18 crore before opening for public subscription, making it the second-highest in the historical anchor investor comparison.

title: Mauritius-based Soach Global to make 25 times return from NSE IPO
description: Mauritius-based Soach Global is set to make nearly 25 times returns on its decade-old NSE investment, with its 82.5 lakh shares now valued at up to Rs 1,472 crore at the IPO price band. The fund is selling 16.5 lakh shares, while retaining 66 lakh shares as a long-term investment.

title: Bank of England sounds inflation alarm as it holds interest rates
description: The Bank of England has decided to hold interest rates steady at 3.75 percent and is currently halting gilt sales. With inflation risks escalating, there are concerns prices may exceed four percent next year. Governor Andrew Bailey indicated that ongoing conflict might require a shift towards tighter monetary measures. Interestingly, three members of the Monetary Policy Committee pushed for a rate hike.

title: Voltas among 7 stocks hitting 52-week low; slipped up to 10% in a month

title: Puravankara Ltd eyes Rs 2,600 cr revenue from redevelopment of 3 housing societies in Mumbai
description: Puravankara Ltd will redevelop three housing societies in Mumbai. The realty firm expects a total revenue of Rs 2,600 crore. These projects are located in Bangur Nagar, Goregaon West, Mumbai. They offer a total developable potential of 1.05 million sq ft. Puravankara has completed 97 projects across various Indian cities.

title: Softer oil buoys India bonds after Fed hike
description: Indian government bonds made a recovery on Thursday, moving past initial setbacks as falling oil prices lessened worries about a potential rate hike from the Reserve Bank of India. The key 6.94% 2036 bond yield ended the day slightly below Wednesday's mark. Overnight indexed swap rates also showed signs of recovery late in the trading session due to the ongoing drop in oil prices.
